overview_description.description: Estaie is a hospitality and travel technology company that operates a platform for extended-stay accommodation bookings. The company focuses on stays ranging from 15 to 365 nights across hotels, serviced apartments, and holiday homes. Its platform uses AI-based pricing and inventory management systems to support long-term booking workflows for individuals, corporate travelers, relocating employees, and property partners. estaie integrates accommodation discovery, booking, pricing, and partner management into a single system for the extended-stay market, primarily serving customers in the Middle East and expanding into additional international markets.
